component.name: PageForge
component.summary: Batch tools for PDFs and images

description.p: PageForge applies one tool to a whole batch of PDFs and images at once, with a live preview of the result. Crop a stack of scans, split a book into chapters, merge files into one PDF or read text from scanned pages.

ul.li: Divide into grid: cut pages into rows and columns, for example a scanned two-page spread into single pages
Auto-crop border: straighten tilted pages automatically or by hand, and trim a border of any colour
Crop margins: trim fixed margins, adjusted by dragging in the preview
Split / Extract: split a PDF at chosen pages, every N pages or into N files, or keep or delete a page list
Organize / Merge: reorder, remove and combine pages from PDFs and images into one PDF
Convert: images to one PDF, images to one PDF each, or PDF pages to images
Rename: name lists, find and replace, numbering, lowercase and space handling
Upscale: enlarge images by a factor or to a target size, with a before and after view
Measure image: distances, areas and angles on images and PDF pages, scaled from a known length or from the perspective of a photo, with drawings laid out on paper at a true scale
Remove background: transparent backgrounds with an AI model or by colour
OCR (zones): read text from columns or zones drawn on each page, with Tesseract
OCR (EasyOCR): automatic text recognition with layout detection

description.p: Opens PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP and TIFF files. Saves PDF, PNG, JPEG and WebP, plain text, CSV and searchable PDF.

Every tool is a Python script in a folder you choose. The built-in tools can be edited, replaced or deleted, and adding a tool means adding one file. Tools that need extra components install them from the settings with one click.

screenshot.caption: Split a PDF into chapters by placing bars between pages
Remove backgrounds with an AI model, before and after
Read text from a magazine page, one zone per text block
Read a newspaper page column by column
Cut a sheet of prints into separate photos
Straighten tilted book pages and trim the scanner border

description.p: A new tool for measuring on images.

ul.li: Measure image: draw distances, areas and angles on an image or PDF page and read them in real units
Set the scale from one line of known length, or from the perspective of a photo taken at an angle
Lay a measured drawing out on paper at a true scale such as 1:100, as a PDF
Options only show when they apply to the current drawing mode

description.p: Straightened scans, updates through GNOME Software, and a fuller app page.

ul.li: Auto-crop straightens tilted pages before trimming, with a rotation adjustment to fine-tune the angle
Generated previews refresh when an option changes
Installs from a signed Flatpak repository, so GNOME Software offers new versions
New app ID io.github.acknar.PageForge; settings, scripts and installed tool libraries are copied from the previous version on first launch
Screenshots, the list of tools and supported formats, and links in GNOME Software

description.p: First Flatpak release of the GNOME edition. Tesseract is included for the OCR (zones) tool.
